limit = { check_variable = { apdc_parl_alliance_fundamentalism > 0 } check_variable = { apdc_parl_alliance_fundamentalism = apdc_parl_alliance_dictatorship } NOT = { has_country_flag = apdc_parl_banned_dictatorship } }
set_country_flag = APDC_governing_coalition_dictatorship
set_variable = { apdc_parl_winner_dictatorship = 1 }
if = {
limit = { check_variable = { apdc_parl_seats_dictatorship > apdc_parl_bloc_leader_seats } }
set_variable = { apdc_parl_bloc_leader = 7 }
set_variable = { apdc_parl_bloc_leader_seats = apdc_parl_seats_dictatorship }
set_variable = { apdc_parl_bloc_leader_support = party_popularity@dictatorship }
set_variable = { apdc_parl_bloc_leader_ties = 1 }

}
else = {
if = {
limit = { check_variable = { apdc_parl_seats_dictatorship = apdc_parl_bloc_leader_seats } }
if = {
limit = { check_variable = { party_popularity@dictatorship > apdc_parl_bloc_leader_support } }
set_variable = { apdc_parl_bloc_leader = 7 }
set_variable = { apdc_parl_bloc_leader_seats = apdc_parl_seats_dictatorship }
set_variable = { apdc_parl_bloc_leader_support = party_popularity@dictatorship }
set_variable = { apdc_parl_bloc_leader_ties = 1 }

}
else = {
if = {
limit = { check_variable = { party_popularity@dictatorship = apdc_parl_bloc_leader_support } }
add_to_variable = { apdc_parl_bloc_leader_ties = 1 }
set_variable_to_random = { var = apdc_parl_draw min = 1 max = apdc_parl_bloc_leader_ties integer = yes }
if = {
limit = { check_variable = { apdc_parl_draw = 1 } }
set_variable = { apdc_parl_bloc_leader = 7 }

}

}

}

}

}

}

if = {
limit = { check_variable = { apdc_parl_interval_supported = 0 } }
log = "APDC_PARL ERROR election interval not in compiled catalogue: [?apdc_parl_interval_months]"

}

}
apdc_parl_set_election_interval = {
set_variable = { apdc_parl_interval_months = apdc_parl_arg_MONTHS }
if = {
limit = { check_variable = { apdc_parl_interval_months > 0 } }
if = {
limit = { has_government = communism }
set_politics = { ruling_party = communism elections_allowed = yes }

}
if = {
limit = { has_government = socialism }
set_politics = { ruling_party = socialism elections_allowed = yes }

}
if = {
limit = { has_government = social_democracy }
set_politics = { ruling_party = social_democracy elections_allowed = yes }

}
if = {
limit = { has_government = liberalism }
set_politics = { ruling_party = liberalism elections_allowed = yes }

}
if = {
limit = { has_government = conservatism }
set_politics = { ruling_party = conservatism elections_allowed = yes }

}
if = {
limit = { has_government = authoritarianism }
set_politics = { ruling_party = authoritarianism elections_allowed = yes }

}
if = {
limit = { has_government = dictatorship }
set_politics = { ruling_party = dictatorship elections_allowed = yes }

}
if = {
limit = { has_government = fascism }
set_politics = { ruling_party = fascism elections_allowed = yes }

}
if = {
limit = { has_government = fundamentalism }
set_politics = { ruling_party = fundamentalism elections_allowed = yes }

}
apdc_parl_sync_election_interval = yes
set_variable = { apdc_parl_elections_enabled = 1 }

}
else = {
if = {
limit = { has_government = communism }
set_politics = { ruling_party = communism elections_allowed = no }

}
if = {
limit = { has_government = socialism }
set_politics = { ruling_party = socialism elections_allowed = no }

}
if = {
limit = { has_government = social_democracy }
set_politics = { ruling_party = social_democracy elections_allowed = no }

}
if = {
limit = { has_government = liberalism }
set_politics = { ruling_party = liberalism elections_allowed = no }

}
if = {
limit = { has_government = conservatism }
set_politics = { ruling_party = conservatism elections_allowed = no }

}
if = {
limit = { has_government = authoritarianism }
set_politics = { ruling_party = authoritarianism elections_allowed = no }

}
if = {
limit = { has_government = dictatorship }
set_politics = { ruling_party = dictatorship elections_allowed = no }

}
if = {
limit = { has_government = fascism }
set_politics = { ruling_party = fascism elections_allowed = no }

}
if = {
limit = { has_government = fundamentalism }
set_politics = { ruling_party = fundamentalism elections_allowed = no }

}
set_variable = { apdc_parl_elections_enabled = 0 }

}
add_to_variable = { apdc_parl_dirty = 1 }

}
apdc_parl_force_election = {
set_variable = { apdc_parl_before_election = apdc_parl_election_serial }
hold_election = THIS
if = {
limit = { check_variable = { apdc_parl_before_election = apdc_parl_election_serial } }
apdc_parl_run_election = yes

}

}
apdc_parl_refresh_regime = {
if = {
limit = { check_variable = { apdc_parl_regime = 1 } }
set_variable = { apdc_parl_base_days = 0 }
set_variable = { apdc_parl_bonus_factor = 0 }
set_variable = { apdc_parl_opposition_factor = 0 }

}
if = {
limit = { check_variable = { apdc_parl_regime = 2 } }
set_variable = { apdc_parl_base_days = 60 }
set_variable = { apdc_parl_bonus_factor = 0.5 }
set_variable = { apdc_parl_opposition_factor = 0.5 }

}
if = {
limit = { check_variable = { apdc_parl_regime = 3 } }
set_variable = { apdc_parl_base_days = 120 }
set_variable = { apdc_parl_bonus_factor = 1 }
set_variable = { apdc_parl_opposition_factor = 1 }

}
if = {
limit = { check_variable = { apdc_parl_regime = 4 } }
set_variable = { apdc_parl_base_days = 120 }
set_variable = { apdc_parl_bonus_factor = 1 }
set_variable = { apdc_parl_opposition_factor = 1 }

}
if = {
limit = { check_variable = { apdc_parl_regime = 5 } }
set_variable = { apdc_parl_base_days = 60 }
set_variable = { apdc_parl_bonus_factor = 0.5 }
set_variable = { apdc_parl_opposition_factor = 0.5 }

}
if = {
limit = { check_variable = { apdc_parl_regime = 6 } }
set_variable = { apdc_parl_base_days = 90 }
set_variable = { apdc_parl_bonus_factor = 0.75 }
set_variable = { apdc_parl_opposition_factor = 0.75 }

}
if = {
limit = { check_variable = { apdc_parl_regime = 7 } }
set_variable = { apdc_parl_base_days = 30 }
set_variable = { apdc_parl_bonus_factor = 0.25 }
set_variable = { apdc_parl_opposition_factor = 0.25 }

}
if = {
limit = { check_variable = { apdc_parl_regime = 8 } }
set_variable = { apdc_parl_base_days = 30 }
set_variable = { apdc_parl_bonus_factor = 0.25 }
set_variable = { apdc_parl_opposition_factor = 0.25 }

}
if = {
limit = { check_variable = { apdc_parl_regime = 9 } }
set_variable = { apdc_parl_base_days = 120 }
set_variable = { apdc_parl_bonus_factor = 1 }
set_variable = { apdc_parl_opposition_factor = 1 }

}

}
apdc_parl_add_communism_attitude_source = {
set_variable = { apdc_parl_source_token = apdc_parl_arg_NAME }
if = {
limit = { OR = { check_variable = { apdc_parl_source_token = token:apdc_parl_source_story } check_variable = { apdc_parl_source_token = token:apdc_parl_source_policy } check_variable = { apdc_parl_source_token = token:apdc_parl_source_agreement } } }
add_to_array = { apdc_parl_communism_source_names = apdc_parl_arg_NAME }
add_to_array = { apdc_parl_communism_source_values = apdc_parl_arg_VALUE }
apdc_parl_refresh = yes

}
else = {
log = "APDC_PARL ERROR unknown attitude source: [?apdc_parl_arg_NAME.GetTokenKey]; register tools/parliament/data/attitude_sources.json"

}

}
apdc_parl_set_communism_attitude_source = {
set_variable = { apdc_parl_source_token = apdc_parl_arg_NAME }
set_variable = { apdc_parl_source_index = 0 }
set_variable = { apdc_parl_source_found = 0 }
while_loop_effect = {
limit = { check_variable = { apdc_parl_source_index < apdc_parl_communism_source_names^num } }
if = {
limit = { check_variable = { apdc_parl_communism_source_names^apdc_parl_source_index = apdc_parl_source_token } }
set_variable = { apdc_parl_communism_source_values^apdc_parl_source_index = apdc_parl_arg_VALUE }
set_variable = { apdc_parl_source_found = 1 }

}
add_to_variable = { apdc_parl_source_index = 1 }

}
if = {
limit = { check_variable = { apdc_parl_source_found = 0 } }
set_temp_variable = { apdc_parl_arg_NAME = apdc_parl_arg_NAME }
set_temp_variable = { apdc_parl_arg_VALUE = apdc_parl_arg_VALUE }
apdc_parl_add_communism_attitude_source = yes

}
else = {
apdc_parl_refresh = yes

}

}
apdc_parl_clear_communism_attitude_sources = {
clear_array = apdc_parl_communism_source_names
clear_array = apdc_parl_communism_source_values
apdc_parl_refresh = yes

}
apdc_parl_change_communism_bill_attitude = {
add_to_variable = { apdc_parl_bill_attitude_communism = apdc_parl_arg_VALUE }
apdc_parl_refresh = yes

}

apdc_parl_refresh = yes

}
apdc_parl_add_fundamentalism_attitude_source = {
set_variable = { apdc_parl_source_token = apdc_parl_arg_NAME }
if = {
limit = { OR = { check_variable = { apdc_parl_source_token = token:apdc_parl_source_story } check_variable = { apdc_parl_source_token = token:apdc_parl_source_policy } check_variable = { apdc_parl_source_token = token:apdc_parl_source_agreement } } }
add_to_array = { apdc_parl_fundamentalism_source_names = apdc_parl_arg_NAME }
add_to_array = { apdc_parl_fundamentalism_source_values = apdc_parl_arg_VALUE }
apdc_parl_refresh = yes

}
else = {
log = "APDC_PARL ERROR unknown attitude source: [?apdc_parl_arg_NAME.GetTokenKey]; register tools/parliament/data/attitude_sources.json"

}

}
apdc_parl_set_fundamentalism_attitude_source = {
set_variable = { apdc_parl_source_token = apdc_parl_arg_NAME }
set_variable = { apdc_parl_source_index = 0 }
set_variable = { apdc_parl_source_found = 0 }
while_loop_effect = {
limit = { check_variable = { apdc_parl_source_index < apdc_parl_fundamentalism_source_names^num } }
if = {
limit = { check_variable = { apdc_parl_fundamentalism_source_names^apdc_parl_source_index = apdc_parl_source_token } }
set_variable = { apdc_parl_fundamentalism_source_values^apdc_parl_source_index = apdc_parl_arg_VALUE }
set_variable = { apdc_parl_source_found = 1 }

}
add_to_variable = { apdc_parl_source_index = 1 }

}
if = {
limit = { check_variable = { apdc_parl_source_found = 0 } }
set_temp_variable = { apdc_parl_arg_NAME = apdc_parl_arg_NAME }
set_temp_variable = { apdc_parl_arg_VALUE = apdc_parl_arg_VALUE }
apdc_parl_add_fundamentalism_attitude_source = yes

}
else = {
apdc_parl_refresh = yes

}

}
apdc_parl_clear_fundamentalism_attitude_sources = {
clear_array = apdc_parl_fundamentalism_source_names
clear_array = apdc_parl_fundamentalism_source_values
apdc_parl_refresh = yes

}
apdc_parl_change_fundamentalism_bill_attitude = {
add_to_variable = { apdc_parl_bill_attitude_fundamentalism = apdc_parl_arg_VALUE }
apdc_parl_refresh = yes

}
apdc_parl_refresh = {
apdc_parl_refresh_regime = yes
set_variable = { apdc_parl_support = 50 }
if = {
limit = { has_government = communism }
set_variable = { apdc_parl_base_attitude_communism = 0 }

}
if = {
limit = { has_government = socialism }
set_variable = { apdc_parl_base_attitude_communism = -10 }

}
if = {
limit = { has_government = social_democracy }
set_variable = { apdc_parl_base_attitude_communism = -20 }

}
if = {
limit = { has_government = liberalism }
set_variable = { apdc_parl_base_attitude_communism = -30 }

}
if = {
limit = { has_government = conservatism }
set_variable = { apdc_parl_base_attitude_communism = -40 }

}
if = {
limit = { has_government = authoritarianism }
set_variable = { apdc_parl_base_attitude_communism = -50 }

}
if = {
limit = { has_government = dictatorship }
set_variable = { apdc_parl_base_attitude_communism = -60 }

}
if = {
limit = { has_government = fascism }
set_variable = { apdc_parl_base_attitude_communism = -70 }

}
if = {
limit = { has_government = fundamentalism }
set_variable = { apdc_parl_base_attitude_communism = -80 }

}
set_variable = { apdc_parl_attitude_communism = apdc_parl_base_attitude_communism }
set_variable = { apdc_parl_source_index = 0 }
set_variable = { apdc_parl_source_tip_communism_1 = 0 }
set_variable = { apdc_parl_source_tip_communism_2 = 0 }
set_variable = { apdc_parl_source_tip_communism_3 = 0 }
while_loop_effect = {
limit = { check_variable = { apdc_parl_source_index < apdc_parl_communism_source_values^num } }
add_to_variable = { apdc_parl_attitude_communism = apdc_parl_communism_source_values^apdc_parl_source_index }
if = {
limit = { check_variable = { apdc_parl_communism_source_names^apdc_parl_source_index = token:apdc_parl_source_story } }
add_to_variable = { apdc_parl_source_tip_communism_1 = apdc_parl_communism_source_values^apdc_parl_source_index }

}
if = {
limit = { check_variable = { apdc_parl_communism_source_names^apdc_parl_source_index = token:apdc_parl_source_policy } }
add_to_variable = { apdc_parl_source_tip_communism_2 = apdc_parl_communism_source_values^apdc_parl_source_index }

}
if = {
limit = { check_variable = { apdc_parl_communism_source_names^apdc_parl_source_index = token:apdc_parl_source_agreement } }
add_to_variable = { apdc_parl_source_tip_communism_3 = apdc_parl_communism_source_values^apdc_parl_source_index }

}
add_to_variable = { apdc_parl_source_index = 1 }

}
if = {
limit = { has_country_flag = APDC_governing_coalition_communism }
add_to_variable = { apdc_parl_attitude_communism = 100 }

}
clamp_variable = { var = apdc_parl_attitude_communism min = -100 max = 100 }
if = {
limit = { has_government = communism }
set_variable = { apdc_parl_attitude_communism = 100 }

}
set_variable = { apdc_parl_bill_support_communism = apdc_parl_attitude_communism }
add_to_variable = { apdc_parl_bill_support_communism = apdc_parl_bill_attitude_communism }
clamp_variable = { var = apdc_parl_bill_support_communism min = -100 max = 100 }
set_variable = { apdc_parl_contribution_communism = apdc_parl_seats_communism }
divide_variable = { apdc_parl_contribution_communism = 500 }
multiply_variable = { apdc_parl_contribution_communism = apdc_parl_bill_support_communism }
multiply_variable = { apdc_parl_contribution_communism = apdc_parl_opposition_factor }
add_to_variable = { apdc_parl_support = apdc_parl_contribution_communism }
set_variable = { apdc_parl_bonus_communism = apdc_parl_seats_communism }
divide_variable = { apdc_parl_bonus_communism = 500 }
multiply_variable = { apdc_parl_bonus_communism = apdc_parl_attitude_communism }
divide_variable = { apdc_parl_bonus_communism = 100 }
multiply_variable = { apdc_parl_bonus_communism = apdc_parl_bonus_factor }

limit = { check_variable = { apdc_parl_bill_kind = 3 } check_variable = { apdc_parl_bill_target = 4 } }
clr_country_flag = apdc_parl_banned_liberalism

}
if = {
limit = { check_variable = { apdc_parl_bill_kind = 2 } check_variable = { apdc_parl_bill_target = 5 } }
if = {
limit = { NOT = { has_government = conservatism } NOT = { has_country_flag = APDC_governing_coalition_conservatism } }
set_country_flag = apdc_parl_banned_conservatism
if = {
limit = { check_variable = { apdc_parl_seats_conservatism > 0 } }
set_variable = { apdc_parl_trigger_election = 1 }

}

}
else = {
set_variable = { apdc_parl_last_result = -1 }

}

}

apdc_parl_validate_agenda = {
set_variable = { apdc_parl_work_tripled = apdc_parl_bill_work }
multiply_variable = { apdc_parl_work_tripled = 3 }
set_variable = { apdc_parl_base_doubled = apdc_parl_bill_base_days }
multiply_variable = { apdc_parl_base_doubled = 2 }
if = {
limit = { check_variable = { apdc_parl_stage = 2 } check_variable = { apdc_parl_support < 0 } }
apdc_parl_fail_agenda = yes

}
if = {
limit = { check_variable = { apdc_parl_stage = 3 } check_variable = { apdc_parl_support < 50 } }
apdc_parl_fail_agenda = yes

}
if = {
limit = { check_variable = { apdc_parl_agenda > 0 } check_variable = { apdc_parl_stage = 1 } NOT = { check_variable = { apdc_parl_work_tripled < apdc_parl_bill_base_days } } }
if = {
limit = { check_variable = { apdc_parl_support > 0 } }
set_variable = { apdc_parl_stage = 2 }

}
else = {
apdc_parl_fail_agenda = yes

}

}
if = {
limit = { check_variable = { apdc_parl_agenda > 0 } check_variable = { apdc_parl_stage = 2 } NOT = { check_variable = { apdc_parl_work_tripled < apdc_parl_base_doubled } } }
if = {
limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { apdc_parl_support < 50 } } }
set_variable = { apdc_parl_stage = 3 }

}
else = {
apdc_parl_fail_agenda = yes

}

}
if = {
limit = { check_variable = { apdc_parl_agenda > 0 } NOT = { check_variable = { apdc_parl_bill_work < apdc_parl_bill_base_days } } }
apdc_parl_pass_agenda = yes

}

}
apdc_parl_submit_agenda = {
if = {
limit = { apdc_parl_can_submit = yes }
set_variable = { apdc_parl_agenda = 1 }
set_variable = { apdc_parl_stage = 1 }
set_variable = { apdc_parl_progress = 0 }
set_variable = { apdc_parl_bill_work = 0 }
set_variable = { apdc_parl_bill_base_days = apdc_parl_base_days }
set_variable = { apdc_parl_bill_kind = apdc_parl_arg_KIND }
set_variable = { apdc_parl_bill_target = apdc_parl_arg_TARGET }
set_variable = { apdc_parl_bill_option = apdc_parl_arg_OPTION }
apdc_parl_refresh = yes
if = {
limit = { check_variable = { apdc_parl_base_days = 0 } }
set_variable = { apdc_parl_progress = 100 }
apdc_parl_validate_agenda = yes

}

}

}

apdc_parl_initialize = {
if = {
limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = apdc_parl_initialized } }
set_country_flag = apdc_parl_initializing
set_variable = { apdc_parl_agenda = 0 }
set_variable = { apdc_parl_stage = 0 }
set_variable = { apdc_parl_progress = 0 }
set_variable = { apdc_parl_term = 0 }
set_variable = { apdc_parl_free_prime = 0 }
set_variable = { apdc_parl_free_deputy = 0 }
set_variable = { apdc_parl_dirty = 1 }
set_variable = { apdc_parl_regime = 4 }
set_variable = { apdc_parl_interval_months = 24 }
set_variable = { apdc_parl_elections_enabled = 1 }
if = {
limit = { original_tag = AAA }
apdc_parl_opening_AAA = yes

}
if = {
limit = { original_tag = ABK }
apdc_parl_opening_ABK = yes

}
if = {
limit = { original_tag = ADU }
apdc_parl_opening_ADU = yes

}
if = {
limit = { original_tag = AFA }
apdc_parl_opening_AFA = yes

}
if = {
limit = { original_tag = AFG }
apdc_parl_opening_AFG = yes

}
if = {
limit = { original_tag = AGR }
apdc_parl_opening_AGR = yes

}
if = {
limit = { original_tag = ALB }
apdc_parl_opening_ALB = yes

}
if = {
limit = { original_tag = ALG }
apdc_parl_opening_ALG = yes

}
if = {
limit = { original_tag = ALS }
apdc_parl_opening_ALS = yes

}
if = {
limit = { original_tag = ALT }
apdc_parl_opening_ALT = yes

}
if = {
limit = { original_tag = AMZ }
apdc_parl_opening_AMZ = yes

}
if = {
limit = { original_tag = ANG }
apdc_parl_opening_ANG = yes

}
if = {
limit = { original_tag = ANU }
apdc_parl_opening_ANU = yes

}
if = {
limit = { original_tag = AOI }
apdc_parl_opening_AOI = yes

}
if = {
limit = { original_tag = ARG }
apdc_parl_opening_ARG = yes

}
if = {
limit = { original_tag = ARM }
apdc_parl_opening_ARM = yes

}
if = {
limit = { original_tag = ASM }
apdc_parl_opening_ASM = yes

}
if = {
limit = { original_tag = AST }
apdc_parl_opening_AST = yes

apdc_parl_daily = {
apdc_parl_initialize = yes
apdc_parl_refresh_special_catalogue = yes
apdc_parl_refresh = yes
apdc_parl_validate_agenda = yes
if = {
limit = { check_variable = { apdc_parl_agenda > 0 } check_variable = { apdc_parl_base_days > 0 } check_variable = { apdc_parl_support_speed > 0 } }
add_to_variable = { apdc_parl_bill_work = apdc_parl_support_speed }
clamp_variable = { var = apdc_parl_bill_work min = 0 max = apdc_parl_bill_base_days }
apdc_parl_refresh = yes
apdc_parl_validate_agenda = yes
apdc_parl_refresh = yes

}
